notes: iPhone 15 Plus (A16), PocketRoofline app 1.0 (1), iOS 27.0.1 (24A446); raw capture kept unmodified in results/captures/. Matrix v1 back-to-back SISO -> LISO -> SILO, one unrecorded warmup, 3 s pause before each repeat. COLD START (thermalState nominal at the first repeat), airplane mode, unplugged, Low Power Mode off, battery 80% -> 80%. SCREEN STILL (uiDuringRepeats still): nothing redrew while a repeat measured; the app updated only in the pauses. SILO STEP: decode 55.88 t/s in the last LISO repeat, 51.19 in the first SILO repeat (fair -> serious), then 34.61, 33.19, 32.42, 30.05 t/s at serious. The step persists with a still screen, so the live chart is not its main cause; its cause is unexplained (README), so no peak-to-sustained percentage is quoted for this phone and its SILO figures are not a sustained-throughput estimate. Repeats whose thermal state changed mid-run are flagged per METHODOLOGY 5. The Headroom bandwidth ceiling for this phone was probed on 24A437, not this build.
